coverage_claim: Seed catalogue, not a systematic or exhaustive literature review.

models.name: Drucker–Prager, nonassociated perfect plasticity
models.note: Smooth Drucker–Prager cone f=q-M p-c with separate dilatancy slope Md. Backward Euler; q direction regularized at 1e-12 p_ref. No tensile cap.

models.name: Sand hypoplasticity + intergranular strain (1997)
models.note: Draft IGS overlay on the von Wolffersdorff base law; compression-positive h and strain. Equation transcription requires independent review before scientific use.

catalogue_sources.locator: Intergranular Strain Extensions; description and references (accessed 2026-10-30); 2024 generalized concept is explicitly referenced. Existing IGS and ISA entries are related lineage candidates, not claims of identical formulations or implementations.

models.name: Sand hypoplasticity — von Wolffersdorff (1996)
models.note: Compression-positive transcription of the von Wolffersdorff stress-rate law. Uses the published Karlsruhe sand parameter example (not Wichtmann calibration). Infinitesimal kinematics; zero spin.

catalogue_sources.locator: Sand Hypoplasticity (von Wolffersdorff, 1996); description and references (accessed 2026-10-30); Existing transcription retained; directory coverage does not constitute independent review.

models.name: Linear isotropic elasticity
models.note: Infinitesimal isotropic elasticity. Demonstration parameters, not calibrated to a soil.

models.name: Modified Cam Clay
models.note: Associated Modified Cam Clay with pressure/void-ratio dependent elasticity, exponential hardening, and backward-Euler integration. Demonstration parameters; finite rotation is unsupported.

models.name: SANISAND — Dafalias & Manzari (2004)
models.note: Original 2004 formulation targeted; pinned implementation-source audit and provisional capability analysis available. Full original-paper extraction and independent review pending.
models.capability_gap: The 25-component layout (26 with multiplier) fits the verified 32-component bound; tensor square and an experimental parent-increment reset scope are available. Full original-paper extraction, canonical reversal/initialization policy, source-variant reconciliation and independent reference execution remain open.

models.name: Terracotta (Terra Cotta) — Wiebicke & Einav (2024)
models.note: A source-pinned Figure 1 research draft now runs in a separate native/Wasm catalogue, with five author-RHS reference histories and analytical checks. Restricted to axisymmetric small strain; independent review and public laboratory admission remain pending.
models.capability_gap: Source-complete journal visual review, original outer-step and mixed-control reconciliation, creep references, independent review and timed browser controls remain open. The draft is not a full 3D law and does not count toward the twenty-model 3D release gate.
